proposition: Independent cyclic indices with unequal cardinalities can share one focus spine; each possible move can expose its remaining support in the source, so the interface shows not only the current address but the lawful neighborhood around it.

layers.WORLD: external object/system being inspected or changed

observed: physical state readable at index line

reconstructed_transfer: Scale Lens: one identity may survive unequal lawful projections
RETURN: consequential operation leaves durable evidence
product-demo lineage: model/world correspondence must be measured rather than assumed
inspiration_not_provenance: Blade Runner / Memory-Orb association is a user-recognized visual/mechanical analogue; no recovered evidence establishes it as the historical source of the cylinder lineage.

body_mapping.rule: A physical body may extrude the proven ring stack later; its ring counts must come from a useful schema rather than a fixed four-state demo.

invariants: Discrete semantic address and continuous transform are not interchangeable controls.
APERTURE reveals/selects scope; it does not silently mutate canonical identity.
ARM snapshots the addressed state and transform before RUN.
RUN acts only on the latched packet and emits RETURN.
Bridge packets traverse the same provenance path as human interaction.
Physical promotion requires state readback without software.

first_physical_return.prerequisite: Use lawful-support AXIAL on real FIELD/HOUSE navigation first. Identify which ring composition and support cues remain useful after repeated use before designing hardware.
first_physical_return.then: Build only that composition as a passive indexed body; choose diameter/travel from ergonomics and material, not from the old 50 mm fixture default.
first_physical_return.question: Does the physical projection preserve the same address/readback advantage after the screen is removed?
first_physical_return.no_claim: The cylinder is optional. AXIAL survives if the focus-stack grammar is useful and the cylindrical embodiment is not.

software_head.name: AXIAL / FOCUS STACK 0.7.1
software_head.interaction: drag annulus / release-to-snap; wheel or keyboard notch; strip token; result→ring inverse alignment
software_head.lawful_support: For each ring candidate v, count source identities satisfying v while all other aligned dimensions remain fixed. support=0 is visible as a dead move, never silently skipped.
software_head.address_serialization: Selected non-ANY dimensions + source + projection + focus serialize into the page URL; reload reconstructs the same focus where the source still contains that identity.
software_head.authority: navigation/readback only; no public HOUSE actuation
software_head.position_feedback: Fixed 12-o'clock focus gate + moving per-ring position witness + ordinal i/n readout. Gate, ring orientation and semantic value are deliberately separate signals.

ring_law: Rings are independent cyclic vocabularies; equal cardinality is never assumed.
A fixed focus spine reads exactly one token per ring.
The aligned tuple is a query/address over a named source, not a claim that the vocabularies are naturally equivalent.
Every candidate token may expose support under the other selected dimensions.
support=0 means the candidate cannot produce an identity under the current other constraints; it remains selectable so contradiction/dead ends stay inspectable.
RING and STRIP are lawful projections of the same selected indices and support relation.
ANY widens one dimension without erasing the other selected dimensions.
Identity→rings and rings→identity must round-trip when the source remains unchanged.
BACK navigates session state; RETURN records a durable focus receipt; neither is silently treated as the other.
Current ring position must be visually legible without inferring it from the source result.
Fixed focus gate and moving position witness are distinct signals: one says where the aperture reads; the other says where the control currently is.

source_adapters.FIELD: Full Focus Stack: FAMILY × KIND × OPERATION × STATE × ROLE over /showcase-manifest.json. Root FIELD embeds a reduced chronology lens: ROUTE × STATE × OPERATION × WORK MODE over durable recent touches.
source_adapters.HOUSE: ROOM × TYPE × CONFIDENCE × ENTITY over /house/spatial/model.json; public model only

APERTURE_UTILITY.boundary: AXIAL composes multiple source dimensions; APERTURE traverses one source across semantic scale/position/time/voice.

SCALE_LENS.boundary: Lens preserves identity across rich projections; AXIAL remains the source-constraint/address compositor.

FU_FOVEATE.boundary: Partial exact fragments prove executable fovea path state; they do not establish the modern AXIAL ring UI as the historical reader.
